purpose: Performance magic as staged experiences of apparent impossibility shaped by attention, narrative, rehearsal, collaboration, and an audience contract.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Distinguish effect from method and perception from inferred intent. Attribute creators, respect unpublished methods, and check participant consent and safety claims.
